review.posthog_relevance: Adds metadata ingestion support for Commercetools warehouse connector, potentially retaining store, channel, customer-group, and state dimensions in warehouse tables.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F2.H1 adds four new resource endpoints to the documentation and configuration for the Commercetools warehouse connector. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it establishes the configuration and documentation support for importing specific metadata dimensions (store, channel, customer-group, state) from Commercetools into PostHog warehouse.
